rules.rationale: This nullary equation expands the named loop-body proof term to the exact translated statement AST; it defines syntax and does not implement an execution step or assert an additional mathematical fact.
This nullary equation expands the named function-body proof term to the exact translated function AST, after which the supplied operational semantics executes that AST.
This is the guarded defining case of pendingSpace for the two-underscore encoding, mapping the next space to the saturated dash encoding.
This is the guarded defining case of pendingSpace that keeps an already saturated dash encoding unchanged.
This is the remaining guarded defining case of pendingSpace, appending one underscore when the pending encoding is neither two underscores nor a dash.
This base equation defines resultAfter on an empty remaining character sequence as the current completed result.
This recurrence defines resultAfter for a leading space by consuming that character, preserving the completed result, and updating the pending-space summary.

Although marked simplification, this is the guarded non-space recurrence that defines resultAfter by consuming one character, flushing the pending encoding, and resetting it; it is not an independent lemma.
This base equation defines pendingAfter on an empty remaining sequence as the current pending-space encoding.
This recurrence defines pendingAfter for a leading space by consuming the character and applying the pendingSpace state transition.
Although marked simplification, this is the guarded non-space recurrence that defines pendingAfter by consuming one character and resetting the pending encoding; it is not an independent lemma.
This base equation defines charAfter on an empty remaining sequence as the existing loop-target value.
This recurrence defines charAfter by consuming one code and recording its one-character string as the latest loop-target value.
This equation defines fixedSpaces as the concatenation of the recursively defined final completed-result and pending-space summaries.
